title: Running DOS on Behringers DDX3216 with a DIY x86-Bios from Scratch
summary: A technical blog post detailing the author's journey of creating a custom x86 BIOS from scratch to run DOS on a Behringer DDX3216 digital mixer, essentially reverse-engineering proprietary hardware to enable legacy operating system functionality.
problem_solved: Enables running DOS on proprietary digital audio hardware that wasn't designed to support standard x86 operating systems.
why_valuable: Demonstrates deep hardware understanding, preserves legacy equipment, and provides educational content for low-level system programming and BIOS development.
